svg.text: Every novel isoform gets a verdict and the reason for it
Four novel isoforms of a toy gene as PanIsoGuard sees them. The ringed evidence is what decided each verdict.

svg.text: explained by the person's own genome
Real output of one run on the toy gene in notes/ (short reads, a long-read BAM, two haplotypes).
Each verdict also keeps its full rule_trace. Caller agreement and pangenome junctions are further optional evidence.
